name: iPhoneDuoIcon
tagline: 电量、Wi-Fi 与蜂窝信号一体化，提供星环和胶囊两种状态栏样式。
description: iPhoneDuoIcon 提供星环与胶囊两种状态栏样式，将电量、Wi-Fi 和蜂窝信号整合为紧凑的信息区域。
胶囊样式整合时间、电量百分比和网络状态，支持双卡独立分段信号，并会根据状态栏可用空间自动避让刘海；电量数字可统一开关。
点击组合图标可动画展开系统原生的蜂窝信号、Wi-Fi 和电池图标；电池沿边界展开，信号与 Wi-Fi 错峰运动，3 秒后自动合拢。
电池、Wi-Fi、5G/LTE 与两张 SIM 卡信号可分别设置颜色；星环和胶囊也可独立调整大小与位置。
支持 VPN 状态着色、充电与低电量模式显示，并提供三语言设置界面。
notice: ⚠️ 当前为测试版，具体机型、VPN 与定位状态兼容性仍需实机复测。与 SingleVPN 冲突。
features: 星环与胶囊两种状态栏样式
共用电量百分比开关同时控制星环和胶囊，默认关闭并即时生效
星环电量百分比支持左侧或顶部缺口位置
星环整体大小、水平偏移与垂直偏移调节，默认保持居中
星环顶部电量百分比支持独立缩放
星环与胶囊分别支持大小、水平偏移和垂直偏移调节，并可一键恢复居中默认值
星环与胶囊专属设置按当前样式互斥显示并即时生效
胶囊电量百分比固定顶部，关闭数字后自动补齐轮廓
胶囊整合时间、电量百分比和网络状态
单卡电量轮廓与双卡独立分段信号显示
根据状态栏可用空间自动调整胶囊大小，空间不足时等比缩小避让刘海
小屏设备保持右侧定位与时间基线，点击区域及展开动画同步适配
电池沿边界展开，信号与 Wi-Fi 错峰运动并带轻微回弹，3 秒后自动合拢
再次点击延长展开停留，并提供三语言操作提示
0–20 pt 右侧留白调节，增大数值可向左移动
电池、Wi-Fi、5G/LTE、卡 1 与卡 2 信号独立配色，自绘动画同步使用所选颜色
自定义配色启用后，VPN、充电、低电量与省电模式不会覆盖用户颜色
颜色一键重置为默认绿色
VPN 状态着色、充电及低电量模式提示
启用开关及简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置
usage: 安装时确认移除存在冲突的 SingleVPN
进入“设置 → iPhoneDuoIcon”选择星环或胶囊样式；两种样式可分别调整大小、水平/垂直偏移与相关专属选项
按需启用独立配色，分别设置电池、Wi-Fi、5G/LTE 与两张 SIM 卡信号颜色；可一键重置颜色或布局
点击状态栏组合图标可展开原生图标；再次点击可延长停留
设置修改即时生效；需要时可使用设置内按钮手动重新加载 SpringBoard

changes: 新增独立配色：电池、Wi-Fi、5G/LTE、卡 1/卡 2 信号可分别设色并同步动画；启用后不再被系统状态颜色覆盖。
星环与胶囊均支持独立大小、水平/垂直位置调节，默认居中并支持一键重置。
新增颜色重置为默认绿色，并优化星环顶部电量数字缩放、宽度与圆弧间距。
新增星环整体大小、水平/垂直偏移与顶部电量独立缩放，默认保持居中。
星环与胶囊专属设置仅按当前样式显示，所有调整即时生效。
优化百分比数字宽度并减少对其他状态栏图标的影响；VPN 与定位兼容性仍需实机复测。
新增共用电量百分比开关，同时控制星环和胶囊；星环支持左侧或顶部缺口位置。
胶囊数字固定顶部，关闭数字时自动补齐轮廓，并隐藏不适用的位置选项。
设置修改即时生效，并兼容旧版开关保存值。
优化展开后原生电池的电量同步，修复偶发显示红色 1% 或缺失电量的问题。
展开交接时及时刷新电池状态，同时保持真实低电量、充电及低电量模式的正确显示。
新增星环左侧电量百分比开关，默认关闭、即时生效，字体跟随系统样式。
重做电池、信号与 Wi-Fi 展开动画，加入边界绕行、错峰曲线与轻微回弹，并保留双卡独立信号和 3 秒停留。
优化小屏胶囊显示与自动刘海避让，空间不足时等比缩小，空间充足时保持原尺寸。
新增自动刘海避让，根据状态栏可用空间调整胶囊大小；空间不足时等比缩小。
优化小屏设备的右侧定位、时间基线、点击区域与展开动画，避免内容被刘海遮挡。
保留右侧留白调节，并更新简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置说明。
新增“星环 / 胶囊”样式；胶囊整合时间、电量百分比与网络状态，并支持双卡独立分段信号。
优化单卡电量轮廓、时间字号与基线、Wi-Fi / 5G 间距，并修复 iOS 16 胶囊显示问题。
设置修改即时生效，新增手动重新加载 SpringBoard 与 0–20 pt 右侧留白调节。
新增 iOS 16 适配。
新增点击展开：组合图标可动画展开系统原生的蜂窝信号、Wi-Fi 和电池图标，3 秒后自动合拢。
优化原生图标的位置与尺寸衔接，减少动画结束时的跳动和生硬切换。
支持再次点击延长停留，并改善动画中断体验及三语言操作提示。
新增电量、Wi-Fi 与蜂窝信号三合一圆形状态栏图标。
支持单卡 4 点与双卡左右独立信号显示，并提供 VPN、充电及低电量模式状态提示。
新增启用开关、圆角设置图标，以及简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置。

en.name: iPhoneDuoIcon
en.tagline: Unified battery, Wi-Fi, and cellular status with Orbit and Capsule styles.
description: iPhoneDuoIcon offers Orbit and Capsule status bar styles that combine battery, Wi-Fi, and cellular information in a compact area.

Capsule mode combines time, battery percentage, and network status, with independent segmented signal indicators for dual SIM and automatic notch avoidance based on available status bar space. One shared switch controls battery numbers in both styles.

Tap the combined icon to reveal the system's native cellular, Wi-Fi, and battery icons. The battery follows the boundary while cellular and Wi-Fi move on staggered paths, then combine again after three seconds.
Battery, Wi-Fi, 5G/LTE, and each SIM signal can use separate colors, while Orbit and Capsule have independent size and position controls.
It includes VPN status coloring, charging and Low Power Mode indicators, and trilingual settings.
en.notice: ⚠️ This is a testing release; device-specific behavior and compatibility with VPN and location status still require device retesting. Conflicts with SingleVPN.
features: Orbit and Capsule status bar styles
One shared battery percentage switch for Orbit and Capsule, off by default and applied immediately
Orbit battery percentage positioned on the left or in the top gap
Orbit size, horizontal offset, and vertical offset controls, centered by default
Independent scaling for the top Orbit battery percentage
Independent size, horizontal offset, and vertical offset controls for Orbit and Capsule, with one-tap layout reset
Style-specific Orbit and Capsule settings shown exclusively for the selected style and applied immediately
Capsule battery percentage fixed at the top, completing the outline when numbers are hidden
Capsule mode with time, battery percentage, and network status
Single-line battery outline and independent segmented dual-SIM indicators
Automatic Capsule sizing based on available status bar space, scaling proportionally when needed to avoid the notch
Small-screen alignment that keeps right positioning and the time baseline while adapting the tap area and unfold animation
Boundary-following battery motion with staggered cellular and Wi-Fi paths, subtle bounce, and automatic recombination after three seconds
Tap again to extend the hold, with localized interaction hints in three languages
Adjustable 0–20 pt right-side spacing; larger values move the item left
Separate colors for battery, Wi-Fi, 5G/LTE, SIM 1, and SIM 2 signals, synchronized with custom animations
User colors take priority over VPN, charging, low-battery, and Low Power Mode colors when customization is enabled
One-tap color reset to the default green
VPN status coloring, charging, and Low Power Mode indicators
Enable switch and settings in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Confirm removal of the conflicting SingleVPN package during installation
Open Settings → iPhoneDuoIcon to choose Orbit or Capsule; configure size, horizontal and vertical offsets, and style-specific options independently
Optionally enable custom colors for battery, Wi-Fi, 5G/LTE, SIM 1, and SIM 2; reset colors or layout with one tap
Tap the combined status bar icon to reveal native icons; tap again to extend the hold
Settings changes apply immediately; use the manual Restart SpringBoard button when needed

changes: Added independent colors for battery, Wi-Fi, 5G/LTE, SIM 1, and SIM 2 signals, synchronized with animations and protected from system status color overrides.
Orbit and Capsule now have independent size, horizontal, and vertical position controls, centered by default with one-tap reset.
Added color reset to the default green and improved top Orbit battery percentage scaling, digit width, and arc spacing.
Added Orbit size, horizontal and vertical offsets, centered by default, plus independent scaling for the top battery percentage.
Orbit- and Capsule-specific settings now appear only for the selected style, with all adjustments applied immediately.
Improved percentage digit width and reduced interference with other status bar icons; VPN and location compatibility still require device retesting.
Added a shared battery percentage switch for Orbit and Capsule; Orbit supports left-side or top-gap placement.
Capsule keeps the percentage at the top, completes its outline when numbers are hidden, and removes the unnecessary position option.
Settings changes apply immediately and remain compatible with values saved by earlier versions.
Improved native battery level synchronization after unfolding, fixing occasional red 1% or missing battery readings.
Battery status now refreshes during the unfold handoff while preserving accurate low-battery, charging, and Low Power Mode indicators.
Added an optional battery percentage to the left of Orbit, off by default and applied immediately with the system battery percentage font.
Redesigned battery, cellular, and Wi-Fi unfold animations with boundary-following motion, staggered curves, and subtle bounce, while retaining independent dual-SIM signals and the three-second hold.
Improved Capsule display and automatic notch avoidance on smaller screens, scaling proportionally when space is limited while preserving full size when space allows.
Added automatic notch avoidance that adjusts Capsule size to available status bar space and scales proportionally when space is limited.
Improved right-side positioning, the time baseline, tap area, and unfold animation on smaller screens to prevent content from being obscured by the notch.
Retained right-side spacing controls and updated the English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese settings descriptions.
Added Orbit and Capsule styles; Capsule combines time, battery percentage, and network status with independent segmented dual-SIM indicators.
Improved the single-line battery outline, time sizing and baseline, and Wi-Fi / 5G spacing, and fixed Capsule display on iOS 16.
Settings changes now apply immediately, with a manual Reload SpringBoard action and adjustable 0–20 pt right-side spacing.
Added support for iOS 16.
Tap the combined icon to reveal the system's native cellular, Wi-Fi, and battery icons; they automatically combine again after three seconds.
Improved native icon position and size alignment, reducing jumps and abrupt switching at the end of the animation.
Tap again to extend the hold, with smoother interrupted transitions and localized interaction hints in three languages.
Added a circular status bar icon that combines battery, Wi-Fi, and cellular status.
Added four-dot single-line and independent dual-SIM signal indicators, with VPN, charging, and Low Power Mode status.
Added an enable switch, a rounded Settings icon, and settings in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
